title: Zillow’s Revenue Jumps as Rentals Offer ‘Bright Spot’
summary: Zillow Group Inc. said Wednesday that second-quarter revenue jumped 18% from a year earlier to $772 million, as the online real estate company sees rental agreements growing more quickly than home purchases on its website and app.

title: MercadoLibre Drops as E-Commerce Giant Signals More Spending
summary: MercadoLibre Inc. shares slid in late trading as analysts worried about the e-commerce giant’s spending plans despite it reporting sales and profits that beat consensus estimates in the second quarter.

title: Avocados at Risk as US Halts Government Work in Michoacán
summary: The US suspended government activities in the Mexican state of Michoacán, affecting imports of avocados from the largest producing region in the country to the US.

title: Asian Stocks Set for Declines as AI Rally Cools: Markets Wrap
summary: Stocks in Asia were poised to ease Thursday as investors digested gains in technology shares while watching for fresh signs of progress toward a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Tech Trade May See Bigger Retail Influence After July Rout, JPMorgan Says
summary: The technology trade may be poised to become even more dependent on retail investors and more volatile after a rough July, according to an assessment of preliminary data on technology, media and telecommunications equity sector hedge funds from JPMorgan Chase & Co.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 6
summary: Oil held losses as Iran said it reached an agreement with Oman on a proposed shipping route through the Strait of Hormuz, raising the prospect of some energy flows resuming through the critical waterway.

title: S&P 500 Edges Lower After $3.7 Trillion Advance: Markets Wrap
summary: Wall Street’s blistering run took a breather, with traders digesting the recent stock gains and monitoring any hints of progress toward a deal to revive the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Hedge Funds Take Big Hit in July After Bruising AI Selloff
summary: A spate of well-known hedge funds reported steep losses in July as AI shares tumbled, most notably forcing the highly leveraged Situational Awareness to sell most of its stock portfolio at a deep discount to Ken Griffin’s Citadel.

title: Fed's Cook 'Prepared to Act' on Rates If Inflation Doesn't Slow
summary: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook cautions that the longer inflation remains above the central bank’s goal, the tougher the job will be to rein it in during remarks at an event in Alaska.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: MNTN CEO on Disney’s Ad Business, Streaming Wars Outlook
summary: MNTN CEO Mark Douglas discussed the current state of the connected TV and streaming advertising landscape following a strong earnings report from his company, which showed a 21% year-over-year revenue increase. The conversation highlighted recent earnings from major media companies, including Disney, which reported a 64% profit growth in its streaming business and 14% revenue growth, though its overall ad sales grew only 3%. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Phillips 66 Expects Soaring Fuel Margins to Last Into 2027
summary: Fuel-makers enjoying skyrocketing profits will likely keep reaping standout margins through the next quarter and beyond, according to an executive from a top US refiner.

title: Carry Trade Is Powering On as Investors Sidestep Yen’s Gains
summary: Emerging-market carry trades, some of this year’s most popular foreign-exchange bets, are showing resilience even after joint US-Japan currency intervention dented the appeal of this yen-funded strategy.

title: Celestica’s $3 Billion Deal Joins Data Center Funding Rush
summary: Celestica Inc. is looking to raise $3 billion from selling new shares, joining a flurry of companies raising funds for data centers to power the artificial intelligence buildout.

title: MetLife’s Earnings Beat Wall Street Expectations
summary: MetLife Inc.’s second-quarter earnings surpassed Wall Street’s expectations, boosted by strong underwriting, volume growth and the success of a five-year plan outlined in late 2024.

title: Duolingo Shares Fall On Tepid Sales Outlook
summary: Duolingo Inc. shares fell as much as 12% on Wednesday after the company’s conservative revenue outlook for the current quarter overshadowed user growth.

title: Yen Seen Gaining 6% Against Dollar by End of 2026, Bank of America Says
summary: The Japanese yen will strengthen about 6% against the dollar by year-end following coordinated currency intervention, according to revised expectations from Bank of America Corp.

title: CME, FanDuel Venture Falters as Prediction Startups Race Ahead
summary: CME Group Inc. and FanDuel are scaling back a joint effort to take on prediction market startups after failing to gain traction in a booming industry that has quickly come to represent a threat to both Wall Street exchanges and traditional sportsbooks.

title: Gold Jumps Most Since February on Hormuz, Technical Breakout
summary: Gold jumped the most since February as prospects for a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz reduced expectations for Federal Reserve rate hikes, while a break above a key technical resistance level fueled additional buying.

title: Stocks Edge Lower as Rate Hike Rumbles Offset Nvidia’s Rally
summary: US stocks closed little changed on Wednesday, erasing an earlier climb, after Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari’s comment that it’s time for the central bank to start slowly raising rates. Megacap Nvidia Corp. extended its rally to a fifth day, boosted by confidence in artificial-intelligence related spending. The stock contributed the most to the S&P 500 Index on a points basis Wednesday.
